posts.post:
the thrift store find that ended up being the best thing in your closet.

keep the label or tear it out?

the guy who spends ten minutes checking his reflection in a window vs the guy who hasn't looked in a mirror all day.

we all know which one feels more confident.

nothing ruins a good jacket like a zipper that sticks. 

we spent a week sourcing a smoother track just because of that one sound.

waking up for an early flight and choosing comfort over style is a lie.

you can have both.
